description.value: The Red Shutter Inn is a small, historic six-room inn at Red Mountain Resort in Rossland, BC, built in the 1960s and now owned by Big Red Cats cat skiing company. It has a casual 'ski club' atmosphere centered on a wood stove lounge and a large outdoor hot tub, and also offers a self-contained A-Frame Cabin next door for groups wanting a basic kitchen. Summer guests can use the BBQ on site, and the inn is a short walk from the resort lifts and close to local restaurants.
